blocks.text: Sunlight Air has cemented its position as a key player in the Philippines’ boutique aviation scene, offering travelers seamless access to some of the country’s most stunning islands. While the carrier is celebrated for its reliable service to Coron, it is now making headlines with an exciting new route to Tablas, Romblon. This expansion reflects the airline’s commitment to connecting travelers with lesser-known paradises while maintaining its signature convenience. Coron: A Consistent Island Favorite For Sunlight Air, Coron is more than just a destination; it is a part of the airline’s origin story. The carrier’s inaugural flight took off for Coron […]...
